summary: Residents ask trustees to weigh how many branches can close at once against what the library can still provide nearby.
realLife: South End advocates proposed limiting simultaneous capital projects and making temporary neighborhood service part of the city's approach to future closures.
inGame: needs: overlapping projects and interim service capacity.

turns.pulledBy: Capital staff can stagger two closures.
turns.what: Trustees request a schedule showing the overlap removed.
turns.writesBack: Residents see the revised period without a nearby branch.

turns.pulledBy: Both construction starts must stay in place.
turns.what: The board asks how both neighborhoods will be served at once.
turns.writesBack: The staffing request identifies the overlapping weeks.
